questions.statement: Which is the correct superlative form of the short adjective "tall"?
questions.context: In an English class in Bogotá, students are learning superlative adjectives to describe natural landmarks.

options.text: The tallest.
options.feedback: For short one-syllable adjectives like "tall", we add "-est" to form the superlative: "the tallest".

options.text: The more tall.
options.feedback: "More" is used for comparative forms of long adjectives, not superlatives of short adjectives.

options.text: The most tall.
options.feedback: "Most" is used with adjectives of two or more syllables, not one-syllable adjectives.

options.text: The taller.
options.feedback: "Taller" is the comparative form used to compare two things, not the superlative.

questions.explanation: Para formar el superlativo de adjetivos cortos de una sílaba en inglés como "tall", se antepone el artículo "the" y se añade el sufijo "-est": "the tallest".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What does the sentence tell us about the Amazon rainforest?
questions.context: Sofia reads a travel brochure about natural places in Colombia: "The Amazon is the largest rainforest in Colombia and in South America."

options.text: It is bigger than all other rainforests in Colombia and South America.
options.feedback: "The largest" means that no other rainforest in that group has a bigger area.

options.text: It is smaller than the other forests in South America.
options.feedback: "The largest" indicates maximum size, not smaller size.

options.text: It is only taller than buildings in Bogotá.
options.feedback: The sentence describes geographic area and rainforest size, not building height.

options.text: It has the same size as all city parks in Colombia.
options.feedback: The text identifies the Amazon as the largest rainforest, not equal to small city parks.

questions.explanation: El superlativo "the largest" expresa que un elemento posee la cualidad en el grado máximo dentro de un grupo comparado.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct sentence to complete the description: "Mount Everest is ________ mountain in the world."
questions.context: In a geography quiz in Medellín, Carlos wants to describe Mount Everest using the adjective "high".

options.text: the highest
options.feedback: "The highest" correctly applies the superlative rule with "the" + adjective + "-est".

options.text: higher than
options.feedback: "Higher than" is comparative and needs two specific elements being compared.

options.text: the most high
options.feedback: "Most high" is incorrect because "high" is a one-syllable adjective requiring "-est".

options.text: highest of
options.feedback: The superlative requires the definite article "the" before the adjective.

questions.explanation: Se utiliza "the highest" porque "high" es un adjetivo corto monosilábico y se está comparando una montaña respecto a todas las demás del mundo.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence correctly uses the superlative form of the adjective "old"?
questions.context: Mateo is writing an email from Cartagena to his pen pal about historic monuments in Colombia.

options.text: Santa Marta is the oldest city in Colombia.
options.feedback: "The oldest" correctly uses the superlative form to state that Santa Marta was founded before any other city in Colombia.

options.text: Santa Marta is the older city in Colombia.
options.feedback: "Older" is a comparative adjective and requires "than" when comparing two cities.

options.text: Santa Marta is most old city in Colombia.
options.feedback: The definite article "the" and the "-est" suffix are necessary for the superlative of "old".

options.text: Santa Marta is the more old city in Colombia.
options.feedback: "More old" is grammatically incorrect in standard English.

questions.explanation: El adjetivo "old" forma su superlativo como "the oldest", indicando la mayor antigüedad entre todas las ciudades de Colombia.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the sentence using the superlative form of "beautiful".
questions.context: A guide in San Andrés Island explains to tourists: "Johnny Cay is one of ________ beaches on our island."

options.text: the most beautiful
options.feedback: For long adjectives like "beautiful" (three syllables), we use "the most" before the adjective.

options.text: the beautifulest
options.feedback: "-est" is not added to multi-syllable adjectives such as "beautiful".

options.text: more beautiful than
options.feedback: "More beautiful than" is the comparative form, not the superlative.

options.text: the most beautifulest
options.feedback: Double superlatives ("most" + "-est") are incorrect in English.

questions.explanation: Con adjetivos largos de tres o más sílabas como "beautiful", se antepone "the most" para formar el superlativo: "the most beautiful".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Based on the chart, which statement is true?
questions.context:
Read the chart with information about three Colombian rivers:
- Magdalena River: 1,528 km long
- Cauca River: 1,350 km long
- Atrato River: 750 km long

options.text: The Magdalena River is the longest river in the group, and the Atrato River is the shortest.
options.feedback: 1,528 km is the maximum length (longest) and 750 km is the minimum length (shortest).

options.text: The Cauca River is the longest river among the three.
options.feedback: The Cauca River (1,350 km) is shorter than the Magdalena River (1,528 km).

options.text: The Atrato River is longer than the Magdalena River.
options.feedback: 750 km is less than 1,528 km, so the Atrato is shorter, not longer.

options.text: The Magdalena River is the shortest river in Colombia.
options.feedback: The Magdalena River is the longest in the data set, not the shortest.

questions.explanation: Al analizar datos numéricos en inglés, "the longest" identifica el valor mayor (1.528 km) y "the shortest" el menor (750 km).
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Why is Pico Cristóbal Colón called "the highest peak" and not La Chorrera?
questions.context:
Read the school report from Manizales:
"Nevado del Ruiz is very high (5,321 m), but Pico Cristóbal Colón is the highest peak in Colombia (5,775 m). La Chorrera is the tallest waterfall in Colombia (590 m)."

options.text: Because Pico Cristóbal Colón has the greatest altitude above sea level among all Colombian mountains.
options.feedback: "Highest peak" refers to mountain elevation above sea level, where Pico Cristóbal Colón reaches 5,775 m.

options.text: Because La Chorrera is a mountain higher than Pico Cristóbal Colón.
options.feedback: La Chorrera is a waterfall, not a mountain peak.

options.text: Because Nevado del Ruiz is taller than both of them.
options.feedback: Nevado del Ruiz (5,321 m) is lower than Pico Cristóbal Colón (5,775 m).

options.text: Because waterfalls are always called peaks in English geography.
options.feedback: "Peak" refers specifically to the top of a mountain, not a waterfall.

questions.explanation: El análisis textual demuestra que "highest peak" se refiere a la mayor altitud montañosa de Colombia (Pico Cristóbal Colón con 5.775 m), diferenciando accidentes geográficos.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which student wrote a completely correct sentence in English?
questions.context: Four students in Cali wrote sentences for a tourism contest about Colombia. The teacher needs to select the only sentence that uses superlative grammar and facts correctly.

options.text: Camilo: "The Tatacoa Desert is one of the hottest places in Colombia, and Tayrona Park has some of the most famous beaches."
options.feedback: Camilo correctly uses "the hottest" (consonant doubling with one-syllable CVC adjective "hot") and "the most famous" (multi-syllable adjective).

options.text: Sara: "The Tatacoa Desert is the most hot place in Colombia, and Tayrona is the famousest park."
options.feedback: "Most hot" and "famousest" are grammatical errors; the correct forms are "hottest" and "most famous".

options.text: David: "The Tatacoa Desert is hotter than all places, but Tayrona is more famousest."
options.feedback: "More famousest" is an incorrect double form combining comparative and superlative markers.

options.text: Laura: "The Tatacoa Desert is the hotest place in Colombia, with the most beautifullest sand."
options.feedback: "Hotest" lacks double 't', and "most beautifullest" is a double superlative error.

questions.explanation: Evaluar la precisión gramatical requiere verificar la duplicación de consonantes en adjetivos cortos CVC ("hot" $\to$ "hottest") y el uso de "the most" con adjetivos polisilábicos ("famous" $\to$ "the most famous").
questions.subject: ingles
